claim_boundary.primary_question: Under one frozen single-H100 adaptation of the upstream Modded-NanoGPT Medium Track Record #17 recipe, do Selective-none and Selective-diag improve validation loss relative to both Muon and original Newton-Muon?
claim_boundary.alignment_label: upstream Modded-NanoGPT Medium Track Record #17 recipe, single-H100 adaptation
reasons_not_unchanged: the archived upstream run used eight H100 GPUs whereas this experiment preserves the global token budget on one H100 by eight-way gradient accumulation

for Newton-family cells, K statistics deliberately aggregate all eight sequential single-H100 microbatches and are not claimed equivalent to a hypothetical eight-rank parameter-owner Newton implementation using only owner-local activations
the experiment adds original Newton-Muon, Selective-none, and Selective-diag to the upstream Muon trainer

the controlled PyTorch 2.8 execution keeps FlexAttention and torch.compile(model) but uniformly disables the optional compiled-autograd wrapper, which otherwise fails in a nested FX trace before the first counted update
the experiment freezes three paired seeds and adds local provenance, integrity, checkpoint, and W&B instrumentation
forbidden_uses: do not call this an unchanged or official Record #17 reproduction
do not use wall time, tokens/s, or steps/s from these concurrent quality jobs as efficiency evidence
do not promote Selective-diag versus Selective-none to the primary comparison family
do not change methods, seeds, target loss, or hyperparameters after observing experiment-44 outcomes

reported_reference_only.use_policy: context only; never pool upstream runs with experiment-44 seeds

archived_execution_environment.evidence_role: immutable upstream execution-log header at the frozen repository commit

local_newton_provenance.role: Newton-Muon optimizer implementation reference and FineWeb10B data provenance; this repository does not contain the archived 455M Record #17 trainer

roles.muon: Record #17 Muon baseline with no K state
roles.original_newton_muon: same Record #17 model and recipe with Newton-Muon; full K for QKV, O, and MLP expansion, and four aligned 1024-by-1024 K blocks for MLP contraction
roles.selective_none: same Newton-Muon recipe as the original control, with only MLP-contraction K removed
roles.selective_diag: same Newton-Muon recipe as the original control, with only the four MLP-contraction K blocks replaced by aligned diagonal scales

methods.only_allowed_newton_family_difference: the MLP-contraction proj_w K representation among original_newton_muon, selective_none, and selective_diag

same_seed_requirements: identical model initialization fingerprint across all four methods
identical training and validation shard fingerprint
identical global-batch data order and starting state
identical architecture and non-contraction optimizer hyperparameters

pre_registered_seed_extension.rule: an ambiguous primary confidence interval is necessary but not sufficient; append all four methods together only if the ambiguity would change the frozen cross-scale paper claim

data_contract.single_gpu_equivalence_rule: request each original eight-rank global batch from the loader before splitting it into eight contiguous microbatches; repeated local-size loader calls are forbidden because shard-boundary discard semantics differ
certificate_requirements: resolved absolute path for every shard
file size and binary header audit
data_contract.formal_policy: all cells must use one accepted preflight data certificate

training_recipe.warmup_restore_policy: after compile warmup restore exact model, AdamW, Muon, K, activation accumulators, data-loader, gradients, and RNG state; then empty CUDA caches, reset peak statistics, and begin counted training at update zero

newton_k_recipe.application_order: apply inverse K to the raw float32 gradient before momentum and Newton-Schulz orthogonalization
newton_k_recipe.single_h100_statistics_scope: aggregate activation statistics from all eight sequential microbatches, totaling 524288 tokens per counted update

training_recipe.formal_checkpoint_policy: save and hash one model-only final checkpoint per completed formal cell as state_step005960.pt; checkpoints may remain on the remote host and need not be included in the analysis handoff
training_recipe.resume_policy: never resume a partially trained cell; preserve it as a failed attempt and restart that cell from initialization

smoke_gate.purpose: cross the first Newton K refresh at counted update 24 and execute post-refresh updates
smoke_gate.schedule_policy: the smoke uses the exact 5960-update learning-rate, momentum, and attention-window schedule prefix; shortening the loop must not rescale any schedule

runtime_contract.actual_hostname_policy: the ephemeral container hostname is recorded in suite and cell manifests; the frozen execution identity is this host domain plus the accepted GPU, runtime, source, and data certificates
runtime_contract.pre_formal_host_amendment: changed from R1 host to the otherwise-idle LLaMA H100 host after read-only preflight and before any experiment-44 smoke or formal outcome; no method, seed, model, data order, hyperparameter, endpoint, or analysis rule changed
runtime_contract.data_path_resolution_policy: the nominal Newton-Muon-official-r0 data path may resolve to the shared Newton-Muon-official FineWeb directory only when the exact 51-file inventory, headers, and full preflight SHA certificate pass

training_runtime_gate.rationale: experiment 44 is a controlled comparison rather than an unchanged upstream reproduction; PyTorch 2.8 is retained for the added FP32 out_dtype GEMM path, while the optional compiled-autograd wrapper is disabled uniformly because it fails around FlexAttention in a nested FX trace before any counted update

runtime_contract.controller_python_role: preflight, orchestration, analysis, and post-training W&B upload
runtime_contract.training_python_role: isolated torch/CUDA training only; W&B import is not required
runtime_contract.quality_parallelism_policy: experiment 44 may run on physical GPU1 while experiment 43 runs on physical GPU0; both must honor the shared physical-GPU locks
runtime_contract.timing_policy: all experiment-44 quality timing is diagnostic and ineligible for efficiency claims

source_snapshot_and_recovery.bootstrap_policy: the live repository may only create and seal the first RUN_DIR source snapshot
snapshot_contents: controller, cell runner, analyzer, source builder, common module, tests, contracts, and README
the recovery launcher, sealed outside the controller directory so snapshot-local tests and recovery never depend on later live-source drift
a complete file-hash manifest and environment certificate
source_snapshot_and_recovery.recovery_policy: recover the same RUN_DIR through its sealed snapshot; live-source drift is recorded but cannot block or alter recovery
source_snapshot_and_recovery.completed_cell_policy: reuse only a cell whose local integrity manifest passes
source_snapshot_and_recovery.incomplete_cell_policy: preserve the incomplete attempt and start a numbered retry from step zero

wandb_contract.upload_timing: after local training artifacts, accepted pointer, analysis, and checkpoint hash are sealed
wandb_contract.upload_failure_policy: mark upload pending and provide upload-only recovery; never retrain a valid local cell because W&B failed

analysis_contract.peak_memory_scope: counted run after the instrumentation warmup reset, including all scheduled and final validation passes; not a training-step-only peak
analysis_contract.common_target_role: secondary trajectory-efficiency endpoint chosen before experiment-44 outcomes so all methods are expected to cross it
analysis_contract.difference_sign: candidate minus reference; negative favors the candidate
summary_requirements: sample standard deviation of paired differences
two-sided 95% paired t confidence interval with n=3 and df=2
